full_description: Four objects are sampled from a 12-category pool; the instruction names ONE of them by color and noun (e.g. 'the red cup'), and the robot lifts that one single-arm among three distractors. Tests target-object grounding (color + noun jointly).
schema: {A}=the named target object, filled by play_once with the literal 'the {color} {noun}' (no '/', so replace_placeholders substitutes it verbatim instead of drawing a random objects_description -> color+noun controlled and always present). {a}=arm. Templates borrowed from adjust_bottle's orientation-free subset (the same set operate_tabletop's pick branch used, {C}->{A}); bottle-orientation wording (head-up/upright/'the bottle') was dropped.
preference: borrowed from adjust_bottle native pool; num of words should not exceed 15
seen: Use {a} to hold {A} from the table
Pick up {A} from the table carefully.
Use {a} to pick up {A} from the table.
Raise {A} from the table using the correct arm, {a}.
Grab {A} and lift it upward from the table.
Use the correct arm to pick up {A}.
Pick up {A} from the table using {a}.
Find {A} on the table and raise it using {a}.
unseen: Pick up {A} using the correct arm
Grab {A} on the table and raise it.
